• Sum of angles is 180°.
• Pythagorean theorem: a² + b² = c².
• Area: ½ × base × height.
• Law of Sines: a/sinA = b/sinB = c/sinC.
• Law of Cosines: c² = a² + b² - 2ab·cosC.

• Sum of angles is 360°.
• Rectangle area: a × b.
• Parallelogram area: a × h.
• Trapezoid area: ½ × (a + b) × h.
• Rhombus area: ½ × (d1 × d2).

• Circumference: C = 2πr.
• Area: S = πr².
• Arc length: (angle/360) × 2πr.
• Sector area: (angle/360) × πr².
• Tangent is always perpendicular to radius.

• Prism volume: Base_Area × h.
• Cylinder volume: πr²h.
• Pyramid/Cone volume: ⅓ × Base_Area × h.
• Sphere volume: ⁴/₃πr³.
• Sphere surface area: 4πr².
Vertical angles formed by intersecting lines are equal.
∠AOC and ∠COB are adjacent (sum = 180°). ∠BOD and ∠COB are adjacent (sum = 180°). Therefore, ∠AOC = 180° - ∠COB = ∠BOD. ∎
If one angle in a scissors mechanism is 40°, the opposite is exactly 40°.
If an angle is 45°, what is its vertical angle?
In an isosceles triangle, the angles opposite the equal sides are equal.
Draw the angle bisector AD to the base. By SAS congruence, △ABD ≅ △ACD. Corresponding angles ∠B and ∠C must be equal. ∎
Roof trusses are built as isosceles triangles so the slope is equal on both sides.
If the top vertex angle is 40°, what is ONE base angle?
The sum of the interior angles of any triangle is 180°.
Draw a line through the top vertex parallel to the base. The alternate interior angles equal the base angles. The three angles form a straight 180° line. ∎
Finding a missing navigation angle: 180° - (α + β).
If two angles are 50° and 60°, what is the third angle?
Any side of a triangle is strictly less than the sum of the other two sides (a < b + c).
The shortest distance between two points is a straight line. Traveling from A to B via point C is always a longer path than line AB. ∎
It is physically impossible to construct a triangle with sides 2cm, 3cm, and 10cm.
If two sides are 5 and 7, what is the MAXIMUM whole number length for the third side?
In a parallelogram, opposite sides are equal and opposite angles are equal.
Draw diagonal AC. Alternate interior angles are equal. With the shared diagonal, △ABC ≅ △CDA by ASA. Corresponding sides and angles are equal. ∎
If one angle of a parallelogram is 60°, what is the adjacent angle?
Duplicate the triangle to form a parallelogram. The area of a parallelogram is base × height. Since the triangle is exactly half of it, S = ½bh. ∎
Calculating fabric needed for a sail.
If the base is 10 and height is 4, what is the area?
In a right triangle, c² = a² + b².
Build a square of side (a+b). Place 4 identical right triangles in corners. Area = (a+b)². Area is also = 4(½ab) + c². Equating yields a² + b² = c². ∎
Finding the screen diagonal of a monitor.
If legs are 3 and 4, what is the hypotenuse?
A segment connecting the midpoints of two sides is parallel to the base and equals half its length.
Extend the midsegment by its own length to form a parallelogram. The opposite side equals the base, proving the midsegment is exactly half. ∎
Finding unreachable distances across a lake.
If the base is 24, what is the length of the midsegment?
The altitude drawn to the hypotenuse divides it into segments (a_c and b_c) such that h² = a_c × b_c.
The altitude divides the right triangle into two similar right triangles. Setting up the ratio of their sides: a_c / h = h / b_c. Cross-multiplying gives h² = a_c × b_c. ∎
If the hypotenuse segments are 4 and 9, the height is √(4×9) = 6.
If segments are 2 and 8, what is the altitude (h)?
The median drawn to the hypotenuse is exactly half the length of the hypotenuse (m = c/2).
The center of the circumscribed circle lies exactly at the midpoint of the hypotenuse. Therefore, the median is simply a radius (R) of this circle. ∎
If a right triangle has a hypotenuse of 10, the median to it is exactly 5.
If the hypotenuse is 18, what is the length of the median?
The three medians of a triangle intersect at a single point and divide each other in a 2:1 ratio.
Draw midsegments connecting the midpoints of the sides. Using similar triangles formed by the midsegments, the intersection point creates a 2:1 scale factor. ∎
If a whole median is 12cm long, the segment from the vertex is 8cm.
If the short segment of a median is 4, what is the length of the whole median?
Drop an altitude to divide the triangle. Apply Pythagoras to both smaller right triangles and substitute the projection segment (b·cosγ). ∎
Calculating flight distance between two diverted planes.
If a=3, b=4, and angle is 90°, what is c?
Express Area S = ½ab·sinC = ½bc·sinA. Divide all by ½abc to get sinC/c = sinA/a. ∎
If side a=10 and sinA=0.5, what is the diameter (2R) of the circumscribed circle?
An inscribed angle equals half the measure of the central angle subtending the same arc.
Draw a radius to form an isosceles triangle. By the exterior angle theorem, the central angle is twice the inscribed angle. ∎
If the central angle is 80°, what is the inscribed angle?
If a tangent (AB) and secant (AC) are drawn to a circle from an exterior point, AB² = BD × BC.
Draw chords AD and AC. △ABD and △ABC are similar because they share ∠B, and the angle between the tangent and chord equals the inscribed angle. AB/BC = BD/AB. ∎
If the exterior secant segment is 4 and the whole secant is 9, the tangent is 6.
If tangent=6 and exterior secant segment=4, what is the length of the whole secant?
A circle can be inscribed inside a convex quadrilateral if and only if opposite sides sum equally (a + c = b + d).
Tangents drawn from an external point to a circle are equal in length. By adding up the 8 tangent segments making the 4 sides, opposite pairs balance perfectly. ∎
If opposite sides are 10 and 15, the other two must also sum to 25.
If sides are 5, 8, 7, and X (in order around the shape), what must X be for a circle to fit inside?
If a line outside a plane is parallel to a line in the plane, it is parallel to the plane.
Assume the line intersects the plane. It must intersect the parallel line inside the plane. But parallel lines never intersect. Contradiction. ∎
Powerlines running parallel to the ground.
How many points do a parallel line and plane share?
If two intersecting lines in one plane are parallel to two intersecting lines in another, the planes are parallel.
If the planes intersect, they form a line. This line must be parallel to intersecting lines, which is impossible. ∎
How many points do two parallel planes share?
If a line in a plane is perpendicular to a slant\'s projection, it is perpendicular to the slant itself.
The line is perpendicular to the projection and the height. Since it is perpendicular to two intersecting lines, it is perpendicular to the entire slanted plane. ∎
If the angle between the height and projection is 90°, what is the angle between the line and projection?
By Cavalieri\'s Principle, integral of constant cross-sectional area over height h yields S·h.
Calculating water capacity of a hexagonal pool.
If base area is 20 and height is 5, what is the volume?
A triangular prism can be perfectly sliced into three triangular pyramids of equal volume. ∎
Volume of the Great Pyramid of Giza.
If base area is 30 and height is 10, what is the volume?
A cylinder is a prism with a circular base. By Cavalieri\'s principle, V = Sh = (πR²)H. ∎
If R=2 and H=10, what is the volume divided by π?
A cone is a pyramid with a circular base. Using the pyramid formula, V = ⅓Sh = ⅓(πR²)H. ∎
If R=3 and H=10, what is the volume divided by π?
Archimedes\' proof: A sphere\'s surface area equals the lateral area of its circumscribing cylinder. Integrating area yields the volume. ∎
Material needed for a soccer ball.
If radius is 3, what is the surface area divided by π?
